sources.label: Official boohooMAN UK men's size guide (Main Range - Tops & Outerwear, cm)

audit: Old chest figures were 4–5 cm low: XS 82 → 86.5, M 92 → 96.5, L 98 → 102.5, XL 104 → 108.5. Official Main Range tops chart is chest only (waist removed; bottoms are sized by waist number) and stops at XL; XXL removed. 2XL–5XL are a separate Plus range (UK 44–50), not stored. UK, US & AUS share one row (34–42). Old /size-guide URL moved to /pages/informational/size-guide.
notes: UK fast-fashion brand targeting younger men. Main Range tops XS–XL = UK/US 34–42 chest; 2XL–5XL are a separate Plus range. Oversized styles are labelled and intended to be roomy. Prices are very low so expect them on secondhand platforms too.
